author: Zintenka
body:
I was banned from TS over a harmless video that I was spammed on Skype from Steven, this is ridiculous.

I posted this link to report Steven for spamming me on Slack, Steam and Skype. This is considered harassment and I keep getting bothered by Zac and Steven and yet I'm looked at as a horrible person.

This is friggin' annoying and I want to bury the friggin' hatchet here, I'll do a report on Zac WHEN he bothers me again and post AUDIO files of him being a jerk.

Now - onto this shit-show.

                                                                              ----------------------------

Number one: It's a youtube video that's meant as a comedy and no genitals were exposed, merely a music video

Number two: I got the link from Steven who kept spamming my Steam, Slack and Skype with completely random things.

Eric is even a witness to the link that was spammed, he invited us both when i blocked Steven on Skype. Eric invited me to the chat because he said that Steven wished to talk to me.

He kept spamming my skype with that link... ask Eric.

Just ask Eric...

Here's the evidence of him spamming my Slack and me asking him to stop.






This is friggin' annoying... so many inconviences...

replies.body:

Sorry about Steven bothering you, the Slack Admins are going over the report and will get back to you once a consensus has been reached on what a proper punishment should be, hopefully sometime in the next day or two. 

Regards,
